s1.syndrome_frame: Progressive facial swelling with orbital involvement and neurologic deficits
salient_findings: Painless, bony-hard swelling of the left cheek
Numbness of the left cheek and weakness in movement of the left upper lip
Expansion of the left maxillary ridge with mobility of primary teeth
Large, well-circumscribed, expansile, heterogeneous mass in the left maxillary sinus
key_facts: 9-year-old boy with left cheek swelling and hyperglobus of the left eye
Hyperglobus first noted 1 year earlier
Swelling of the left cheek developed 6 months later
Marked progression of swelling over the preceding 3 months
Normal overlying skin
Numbness of the left cheek and weakness in movement of the left upper lip
No other neurologic deficits, no visual disturbances, and ocular motility intact
Expansion of the left maxillary ridge with mobility of primary teeth c, d, and e
Large, well-circumscribed, expansile, heterogeneous mass in the left maxillary sinus
Deviation and destruction of the nasal septum
Invasion of the ethmoid sinus
Thinning, displacement, and perforation of the anterior wall of the sphenoid sinus
Destruction of the pterygoid plates
Elevation and perforation of the left infraorbital rim
Extreme postero-superior displacement of the second molar toward the inferior orbital fissure
Compromise of the nasopharyngeal space
Seasonal allergic reactions and glucose-6-phosphate dehydrogenase deficiency
WBC 19 × 10³/μl, RBC 3.66 × 10⁶/μl, hemoglobin 10.6 g/dl, hematocrit 33.2%, and MCHC 31.9 g/dl

Squamous cell carcinoma of the maxillary sinus

per_call: Giant cell tumor of the jaw
Squamous cell carcinoma of the maxillary sinus
Rhabdomyosarcoma of the head and neck

shortlist.label: Cherubism
shortlist.why_kept: Characterized by bilateral enlargement of the jaw, which matches the patient's cheek swelling and hyperglobus

shortlist.label: Fibrous dysplasia
shortlist.why_kept: Can cause facial asymmetry and swelling, consistent with the patient's presentation

shortlist.label: Juvenile ossifying fibroma
shortlist.why_kept: A rare, aggressive tumor that can cause facial swelling and destruction of surrounding bone

shortlist.label: Central giant cell granuloma
shortlist.why_kept: Can cause localized swelling and destruction of the jaw, consistent with the patient's radiographic findings

shortlist.label: Ewing sarcoma
shortlist.why_kept: A malignant tumor that can cause rapid growth and destruction of bone, consistent with the patient's aggressive clinical course
